title: Freedom in Christ
definition: Freedom in Christ is the believer's liberation from condemnation, slavery to sin, and bondage to man-made righteousness.
summary: Christ sets believers free to live by grace and walk in holiness.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the liberating Savior who makes His people truly free.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Freedom in Christ helps explain how God saves sinners through Jesus Christ rather than through human merit, religious performance, or self-rescue. This doctrine shows that salvation is personal, covenantal, and centered on the finished work of Christ.

Scripture presents this truth so believers can understand the grace they have received and proclaim the Gospel with clarity. It guards the Church from confusion by keeping sin, grace, faith, repentance, righteousness, forgiveness, and eternal hope in their biblical order.

The heart of this doctrine is christ sets believers free to live by grace and walk in holiness.. It should lead to worship, assurance, humility, holiness, and a deeper confidence in the Savior who saves completely.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because people easily drift toward either despair or self-righteousness. Freedom in Christ reminds believers that salvation belongs to the Lord, rests in Christ, and produces real transformation without turning grace into license or obedience into a way to earn acceptance with God.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility and examine whether your hope is resting in Christ. Let freedom in christ shape your prayers, your witness, your repentance, and your daily confidence that Jesus is able to save and keep all who come to God through Him.
